title: Concept: CSRF protection disabled (csharp) — review required
description: In csharp, [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] removes the unguessable-token check browsers cannot forge. Exempted endpoints trust ambient credentials alone. The remedy is restoring auto-validate filters.
applicability: csharp web handlers and configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Cross-site request forgery on state-changing endpoints; MEDIUM severity, HIGH for account and payment actions.
